context: Modal renders an overlay and content box on top of the page. It was getting clipped by an ancestor's overflow:hidden and stacking under other fixed elements.
explanation: Safe to merge. Rendering through createPortal into document.body takes the modal out of the normal DOM hierarchy so it's no longer subject to an ancestor's overflow or z-index/stacking-context constraints, while React's event system still bubbles events through the component tree as before. The escape-key handling and cleanup are unchanged and correct.
